question: If a fixed480Hz servo still leaves480/960Hz native sensitivity, can a common Cartesian reference slew bound remove abrupt approach commands while retaining an interpretable force-limited task?

native960_startup_gripper_observation.scope: Normal per-pair finger resultant; balanced finger forces can cancel in the wrist resultant. Startup spike retained, not removed or redefined. Does not establish a limit on all contact loads.

interpretation: The largest paired initial axial static task-space spring cap is14.11N before deadzone, below the unchanged20N raw wrist abort. This is an axial controller calculation, not a bound on the norm of the complete dynamic wrist reaction. It does not explain away force aborts.

The first insert command requests a34.7?41.0mm position change. After existing EMA, the first step still advances the reference1.04?3.94mm; measured fine-resolution approach speeds reach57.2mm/s before contact.

Finite reference jumps, arm/hand inertia, implicit gripper coupling and native contact resolution can produce reactions above the static axial spring term. Existing evidence does not uniquely identify their individual contributions.
The initial960Hz finger spike remains an observed modeled transient. It may involve coarse-initialization warm start or gripper constraints; no signal correction or causal attribution is established.

prospective_final_variant.launch_condition: Only if the registered fixed480Hz-servo480/960Hz pair fails; no GPU launch authorized by this evidence file itself.
prospective_final_variant.norm: Euclidean XYZ reference increment per external servo interval
prospective_final_variant.initial_reference: Actual robot tool pose captured between jobs. This initializes controller reference state, not simulator state, and adds no actor observation.
prospective_final_variant.rationale: 20mm/s gives41.7micrometre increments at480Hz, below configured57micrometre radial clearance, while a34.7?41.0mm reference move takes1.74?2.05s after the1s hold. The8.47mm/s gap-based lower bound and27.36mm/s geometric-resolution guideline bracket20mm/s. These are reference-resolution and exposure calculations, not physical speed/force guarantees.
prospective_final_variant.comparison: Reuse both no-slew fixed480Hz-servo reference runs; rerun the same28 cases at native480/960 with the common XYZ limiter. Do not adjust the rate based on those outcomes.
prospective_final_variant.implementation_contract: Record requested world reference, interpolated reference and final clamped impedance target separately. Prefer limiting the requested reference before the unchanged position-error clamp; verify actual final-target behavior rather than assuming it inherits the reference slew bound. Keep terminal-hold behavior explicitly recorded.
prospective_final_variant.scope: This is a shared task/controller correction. All historical comparisons remain separate; any later learning or stronger retry comparison must use this same declared transformation.

alternatives.force_regulated_first_attempt: Do not add a new regulator in this last variant. Frozen retry overrides insertion_load_n to4N, not its8N dataclass default; its first insert phase does not use the regulator. Applying regulation there would add a new controller, feedback lag and tuning/anti-windup questions and could remove the witnessed-failure assay. It is less isolated than common reference slew.
alternatives.unmeasured_soft_contact_stiffness: Do not invent stiffness/damping to suppress peaks without independent physical calibration. It changes the mechanical model and introduces additional free parameters.
alternatives.retry_strength: Apply the reference bound to every controller. Do not weaken retry alone or remove difficult cases; later strong-retry controls may be improved only prospectively under the same corrected task.

verification_and_stop: Require native timing, source snapshots, action/sensor/RNG contracts, raw-abort replay and positive controls to pass for both resolutions.
Report actual contact-onset speed, native force, resultant normal impulse, startup finger load, preterminal and absorbing exposures, and each case. Preserve every force abort and failed launch.
A prefix gate pass is insufficient if it merely delays contact beyond4s. Report actual witnessed contact stalls and perform the already-required common full-job controls before substantial training.

This is the final declared explanation-driven variant if reached. If it fails to establish an interpretable retained-grasp task, retain the numerical/control sensitivity result and stop adding knobs in this cycle.
scope_and_limitations: All calculations use already-charged development trajectories and source inspection; no new simulator work or optimization.
The target slew bound is not a hardware safety claim, actual tool-speed guarantee, force ceiling, convergence proof or success promise.
Geometry uses configured dimensions; radial clearance as a reference-step guideline does not calibrate collision meshes or contact compliance.
Initial parameter ranges are paired28-case realized draws. They do not replace full declared randomized support or justify outcome-conditioned case selection.
